name: code-animation-z5
task: Use the code-animation-prompts skill to make a 12-second New Year opening title in style Z5 (paper-cut), 16:9, 1920×1080, 30 fps. On-screen text: "A new year, anything is possible". Red paper, cream rice paper, layered shadows. No sound. Deliver an editable HTML file, keyframe previews and an MP4 in ./out in this folder. If rendering needs Python packages, install them into a virtual environment in this folder (.venv); do not install anything globally. If something is missing, say exactly what. Answer in English and don't ask me questions.
